acceptance_results.evidence: The new test (import invalidates cached totals for existing sessions, covering two concurrent sessions) fails on a fresh generator-built fixture without the fix and passes with it; the full suite is 9/9 green after the change.

The report names the exact gap — CSV import never invalidates the per-session aggregate cache, so only existing sessions see stale totals — and explicitly rules out the red herrings: aggregation is synchronous and the edge cache is not wired to this path. No TTL shortening or blanket cache disabling.
The diff touches only src/import.js (+4/-1: optional sessionCache parameter with invalidateAll after the write) and the import test file; no other subsystem changed.
